params.name: order
params.description: Sort order in the form `<field>:asc|desc`. Allowed fields: `created_date` and `updated_date`.

params.name: created_from
params.description:
Inclusive lower bound for creation date (ISO-8601 datetime). Must be
paired with `created_to`.

params.name: created_to
params.description:
Inclusive upper bound for creation date (ISO-8601 datetime). Must be
paired with `created_from`.

params.name: updated_from
params.description:
Inclusive lower bound for last-updated date (ISO-8601 datetime). Must be
paired with `updated_to`.

params.name: updated_to
params.description:
Inclusive upper bound for last-updated date (ISO-8601 datetime). Must be
paired with `updated_from`.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return.
